steps.text: A bowl would hold plenty of water. However, it must be made from the metal of the sun, and it must be blessed.

Gujuo takes out a small scroll and some charcoal and draws a rough sketch. When he has finished, he gives the sketch to you.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Here, this is what the vessel should look like... I hope that helps.
If the player has the sketch:

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Similar to the one in the picture I have already given you.

options.text: How do I bless the vessel?

steps.player: How do I bless the vessel?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: When you have made the vessel, bring it to me. I will help but you need to ensure that you are devout and have faith. Your Prayer will be thoroughly tested.

steps.player: Ungadulu called me 'Vacu'. What does that mean?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: It seems that Ungadulu has started to lose his senses. In the days of our forefathers, the 'Vacu' were shamans who could summon powerful, wise spirits.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: But they asked too much, and were enslaved by the spirits they sought to command.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Indeed. Every Kharazi child knows not to mess with evil spirits. What has our shaman gotten himself into?

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: You're more than welcome, Bwana.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: I have work to do Bwana, best of luck on your quest...
Gujou disappears in the Kharazi Jungle as swiftly as he appeared...

metal-of-the-sun-looking-at-the-sketch.text: It's a hastily-scribbled charcoal drawing, depicting a bowl. This is what Gujuo was referring to when he said that you needed to make a vessel made from the metal of the sun.

metal-of-the-sun-making-the-golden-bowl.prompt: Would you like to make a golden bowl?

steps.text: With only 1 gold bar:
You need two Gold Bars to make a bowl.
With 2 gold bars:
You forge a beautiful bowl from solid gowl.

metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-gujou-with-a.speaker: Gujuo
metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-gujou-with-a.text: Greetings, Bwana. Ah, I see you have the golden bowl! Would you like me to bless it for you?

steps.text: With less than 42 prayer:

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Bwana... your faith is not strong enough to bless this vessel.
You need a Prayer level of at least 42 to complete this task.
With at least 42 prayer:

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Very well, Bwana...
Gujuo places the bowl on the floor in front of you, and leads you into a deep meditation...

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Ohhhhhmmmmmm.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Ohhhhhmmmmmm.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Ohhhhhmmmmmm.
You fall into a deep trance. When you awaken, you feel perfectly at ease, as though the gods themselves have smiled upon you.
The bowl is blessed!

options.text: No thanks, I need help with something else.

steps.text: Continues from above with "Bwana! Have you found Ungadulu?"

metal-of-the-sun-using-a-golden-bowl-on-.speaker: Gujuo
metal-of-the-sun-using-a-golden-bowl-on-.text: Well done, Bwana! This is a fine vessel for the sacred water. Shall I show you how to bless it?

options.text: Yes, I'd like to bless my golden bowl.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Very well, let me know when you want to try.
Continues from above with "Bwana! Have you found Ungadulu?"

metal-of-the-sun-using-any-other-item-on.speaker: Gujuo
metal-of-the-sun-using-any-other-item-on.text: Sorry, but I don't need that, Bwana.

metal-of-the-sun-looking-at-the-water-po.text: A pretty babbling spring. The water bubbles with a strange effervescence.

metal-of-the-sun-investigating-the-water.text: The water's hard to reach with all these rocks around. There's a narrow gap, but you'll struggle to fit a container through it.

metal-of-the-sun-using-a-hollow-reed-on-.text: You use the hollow reed to siphon some water from the pool into your vial The water doesn't seem as sparkly as it looked in the pool.
The hollow reed is soaked through with water.
You use the hollow reed to siphon some water from the pool into your vial The water doesn't seem as sparkly as it looked in the pool.
The hollow reed is soaked through with water.
You use the hollow reed to siphon some water from the pool into your enchanted vial. The water bubbles and sparkles as if alive.
The hollow reed is soaked through with water.

metal-of-the-sun-using-the-golden-bowl-o.text: You splash some sacred water on the flames.

metal-of-the-sun-searching-the-desk.text: You give the desk a good search, and find an interesting tome. It looks heavy and very unique.

metal-of-the-sun-searching-the-desk-sear.text: You give the desk a good search, but you find nothing else of interest here.

metal-of-the-sun-reading-the-shaman-s-to.text: You read the ancient shaman's tome. It is written in a strange sort of language but you manage a rough translation...

...scattered are my hopes that I will ever be released from this flaming Octagram. It is the only thing that will contain this beast within. Although its grip over me is weakened with magic, it is hopeless to know if a saviour would guess this. I am doomed...

metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.text: The shaman seems to be fighting an inner battle.

metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.text: Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn.
The thing that was the shaman begins to chant...

metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.text: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...
You feel a strange power coming over you...
The thing seems to get stronger!
Just in time, the shaman wrests back control.

metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.speaker: Ungadulu
metal-of-the-sun-talking-to-ungadulu.text: Run, Bwana! Stay away from here!

metal-of-the-sun-casting-confuse-weaken-.text: Inside the fire wall if successful:

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Thank you, Bwana! You have released me from the demon's grasp, but only for a short while! You must seek out the Book of Binding - it's hidden in these caves somewhere!.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: There are many trials you must pass... but please, you're my only hope of escape!
The shaman's eyes roll back and he returns to his quiet, unassuming self.

metal-of-the-sun-casting-confuse-weaken-.text: Inside the fire wall if unsuccessful:

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: What...what's happening...
The shaman somehow resists the power of the spell.
Perhaps you should try again?
The spell fizzles and has no effect as it passes through the flames.
You feel certain that your weapon would melt if you tried to attack through these magical flames.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
steps.text: Ha ha ha ha! Die, Vacu!
Ungadulu casts a spell!
Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.
The player is knocked outside the fire wall and dealt a small amount of damage.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
steps.text: Foolish Vacu... come for me again and thou shalt taste more of my power!

metal-of-the-sun-investigating-the-fire-.text: The flames form a solid wall, rising straight up out of the ground. There's something odd about it...

metal-of-the-sun-investigating-the-fire-.prompt: What would you like to do?

options.text: Leap out of the flaming octagram.

steps.text: This is quite dangerous, but you find a suitable location to jump.
You take a run up...
You sail over the top of the flame wall...
Getting only slightly singed as you go.

book-of-binding-searching-the-bookcase.text: After perusing the empty bookcase for a while, you decide to check behind it. There's a crevice in the wall! You might just be able to force your way through if you were in any way athletic.

book-of-binding-searching-the-bookcase.prompt: Would you like to squeeze into the crevice?

steps.text: You successfully squeeze through the crevice into a small tunnel.
You decide not to try and squeeze yourself into that ridiculously small crevice.

book-of-binding-going-back-through-the-c.text: It looks like a crevice, you could possibly squeeze through.
You search the crevice. It looks as if you might be able to squeeze through, would you like to try?

steps.text: You squeeze your way through the crevice.
You decide not to try and squeeze your way through the crevice.

book-of-binding-opening-the-first-ancien.text: You push on the doors, they're really shut. It looks like the doors have a huge locking mechanism. Although ancient, it looks very sophisticated.

book-of-binding-lockpicking-the-ancient-.text: You attempt to pick the lock...
You carefully insert your lockpick into the lock.
You feel for the pins and levers in the mechanism.
You tumble the lock mechanism and the door opens easily.

book-of-binding-opening-the-gate-from-th.text: You see a lever and pull it, opening the door.
The doors close with a satisfying click.

book-of-binding-smashing-the-boulders-to.text: You swing your pick at the rock.
You manage to smash the rock to bits.
Another boulder drops down behind you.
You swing your pick at the rock.
You only succeed in scratching the rock.
The pick clangs heavily against the rock face and the vibrations rattle your nerves.

book-of-binding-opening-the-second-ancie.text: If going further into the cave:

steps.text: Two huge metal doors bar the way forward. There is an intense and unpleasant feeling from this place and as you peer through the cracks in the door you see why.
You can just about see dark, shadowy shapes flitting around in the still, dark air...

book-of-binding-opening-the-second-ancie.text: You push the doors. They're quite stiff... they won't budge with a normal push. Do you want to try to force them open with brute strength?

book-of-binding-opening-the-second-ancie.prompt: Use brute strength on the gates?

options.text: Yes, I'm very strong, I'll force them open.

steps.text: You ripple your muscles and prepare to exert yourself...
You brace yourself against the doors...
You start to force the doors open...
You push and push...
One of the following is picked:
If successful:
...and your effort results in the doors opening just enough for you to force yourself through.
If unsuccessful:
...but you run out of steam before you're able to force the doors open. You feel exhausted.
You decide against forcing the doors.

book-of-binding-crossing-the-jagged-wall.text: You prepare to jump over the crumbling wall.

steps.text: You take a good run up and sail majestically over the wall.
You land perfectly!
You fail to jump the wall properly and clip it with your leg.
You're thrown off-balance, and hit the floor with a thud.
The fall knocks the wind out of you.

book-of-binding-using-the-marked-wall.text: You don't see any way to use that.
Perhaps you should search the door?

book-of-binding-searching-the-marked-wal.text: You find five slightly round depressions and some strange markings. There is a lot of dirt and mould growing over the markings, but you clear it out. It looks like some kind of message - would you like to try and read it?

steps.text: 'Place five stones of magical power - but place them wrong, and your fate will sour. First is the spirit of man or beast, second the place where fools tread least. Third is the soil where plants do grow - and four and five are the rules you must know. Solve this riddle, and overcome your ignorance; arranged correct, it should make sense.

book-of-binding-searching-the-marked-wal.text: A Soul Rune is removed from the player's inventory.
You slide the Soul Rune into the first depression. It glows slightly and then merges with the wall. The letter 'S' appears where the Soul Rune merged with the wall.
A Mind Rune is removed from the player's inventory.
You slide the Mind Rune into the second depression. It glows slightly and then merges with the wall. The letter 'M' appears where the Mind Rune merged with the wall.
An Earth Rune is removed from the player's inventory.
You slide the Earth Rune into the third depression. It glows slightly and then merges with the wall. The letter 'E' appears where the Earth Rune merged with the wall.
A Law Rune is removed from the player's inventory.
You slide the Law Rune into the fourth depression. It glows slightly and then merges with the wall. The letter 'L' appears where the Law Rune merged with the wall.
A Law Rune is removed from the player's inventory.
You slide the Law Rune into the fifth depression. It glows slightly and then merges with the wall. The letter 'L' appears where the Law Rune merged with the wall.
You place the last rune and the illusory wall fades away, revealing a door. Would you like to go through?

steps.text: You decide to stay where you are.

book-of-binding-using-the-marked-wall-af.text: You walk through the magical doorway...

steps.text: ...and emerge in a large cavern filled with pools of water.
You appear in a small walled cavern.
There seems to be an exit to the south east.

book-of-binding-searching-the-marked-wal.text: You find the word 'SMELL' carved into the rock wall, by the outline of the door. What would you like to do?

options.text: Read the message on the wall?
Investigate the outline of the door.

steps.text: Same as above starting from "You place the last rune and the illusory wall fades away, revealing a door."

book-of-binding-searching-the-buried-ske.text: It looks as though some poor unfortunate soul died here.
There's nothing interesting about this remains.

book-of-binding-looking-at-the-carved-ro.text: It's meant to look like a stalagmite, but there's something unnatural about it. Looking carefully, you notice a strange carving on the rocky surface.
You see a faded inscription on the rock. 'Once there were crystals to make the pool shine. Ordered in stature to retrieve what's mine.'
You carefully move the gem closer to the rock.
The [gem name] glows and start spinning as it hovers over the rock.
The gem soon begins to fade.
The player is dragged to the middle of the room.
You feel a powerful force picking you up....
All the gems suddenly appear again...
Magic flies from the gems into the center of the room.
Suddenly the room is lit up with a brilliant light...
...Strangely a book appears near the middle of the room.

book-of-binding-talking-to-gujou.speaker: Gujuo
book-of-binding-talking-to-gujou.text: How goes your quest to release Ungadulu, Bwana?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Be wary, Bwana. The jungle is full of strange and powerful spirits. You may have been tricked...

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: That sounds odd. Perhaps our shaman has lost his mind. My apologies, Bwana, it seems that I've sent you on a fool's errand. Unless...

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.
Can we still get your people together?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: We do have a sacred pool which contains pure water. I don't know why Ungadulu would need it, though. Maybe you should talk to him again and get more information.

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Farewell, Bwana, and good luck on your quest.

options.text: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames.

steps.player: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Hmm... we have a pool of pure, sacred water nearby. I wonder if that's what Ungadulu meant?

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.
Can we still get your people together?

steps.player: Can we still get the people together?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: I am sorry, Bwana. Without the totem pole, it isn't safe to gather together. The evil spirits could strike at any time...

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.
Where is this sacred pool of yours?

steps.player: Where is this sacred pool of yours?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: If Ungadulu has requested your help, I suppose I can tell you. It's in the centre of the Kharazi jungle.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: But be careful! The water contains special properties which will only be retained if it's stored in a blessed vessel made from the metal of the sun.

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.
Metal of the sun... what is that?
I'm not sure what to do?

steps.player: I'm not sure what to do.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Don't you need to take some pure water down to the caves? If you haven't got the water yet, try getting some from the pool.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: I am sorry Bwana, but I have no adventuring experience to speak of. I would only get in your way...

options.text: I'm not sure what to do.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: You're more than welcome, Bwana.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: I have to collect herbs now, Bwana...
Gujuo disappears into the Kharazi Jungle as swiftly as he appeared...

book-of-binding-hitting-ungadulu-while-h.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
book-of-binding-hitting-ungadulu-while-h.text: Vile serpent, thou wilt pay for that!
The vial smashes on Ungadulu, soaking him in sacred water.

book-of-binding-hitting-ungadulu-while-h.speaker: Ungadulu
book-of-binding-hitting-ungadulu-while-h.text: ...What, what happened? Why am I all wet?

book-of-binding-using-the-binding-book-o.text: You open the Book of Binding in front of Ungadulu and a supernatural light emanates from the pages. Ungadulu's face twists and contorts in wild spasms.

book-of-binding-using-the-binding-book-o.speaker: Ungadulu (possessed)
book-of-binding-using-the-binding-book-o.text: Curse you... foul intruder... wretched Vacu! Thy meddling ways hath brought thee to thy doom!
Ungadulu drops to the floor, unconscious. From his prone body rises the shape of an enormous, angry demon...

book-of-binding-using-the-binding-book-o.speaker: Nezikchened
book-of-binding-using-the-binding-book-o.text: Thy faith will help you little here.
A sense of hopelessness fills your body.
The player's prayer points are drained.
If the player soaked Ungadulu with holy water before using the binding book:

steps.text: The holy water starts smoking on the demon's skin.

steps.speaker: Nezikchened
steps.text: Argh! It burns...!

book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.speaker: Nezikchened
book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.text: Ha ha ha... I shall return for thee when the time is right.

book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.speaker: Nezikchened
book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.text: But I will leave thee with a taste of my power...
As he finishes the incantation, a powerful bolt of energy strikes you.

book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.speaker: Nezikchened
book-of-binding-upon-defeating-nezikchen.text: Nezikchened: Ha ha ha ha ha!
The demon vanishes, leaving nothing but a pile of ashes where he stood.

book-of-binding-attempting-to-attack-ung.speaker: Ungadulu
book-of-binding-attempting-to-attack-ung.text: Hey! That's no way to treat a shaman.
Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.

book-of-binding-attempting-to-attack-ung.speaker: Ungadulu
book-of-binding-attempting-to-attack-ung.text: I hope that teaches you to respect your elders!

book-of-binding-touching-or-investigatin.text: You feel completely fine to walk through these flames.
The magic of Ungadulu's spell protects you from the flames.

growing-a-yommi-tree.speaker: Ungadulu
growing-a-yommi-tree.text: Bwana, you've saved me from the demon Nezikchened! How can I ever repay this favour?

options.text: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.

steps.player: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Yommi tree seeds? To grow a new totem? Then Nezikchened's influence has spread further than I thought...

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: You should know that growing a Yommi tree is no simple task - but I'll help you as much as I can.
The Shaman holds out his gnarled old hand and reveals three largish green seeds.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Here you are, take these with my gratitude. You'll need to soak them in sacred water to germinate them before planting them.

options.text: How do I grow the Yommi tree?

steps.player: How do I grow the Yommi tree?

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: First you will need to soak the seeds in some sacred water. This will help them germinate and begin the growing process.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Next, you'll need to find a patch of fertile soil and plant the seeds.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Yommi trees are magical, and grow very quickly. You'll need to water them often with more sacred water - there should be plenty in the spring.

options.text: What do you know about the sacred water?
What do you know about the sacred water?

steps.player: What do you know about the sacred water?

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: The sacred water comes from a magical spring, the source of which lies deep underground.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Legend has it that the water is protected by spirits of long-dead adventurers who went in search of the spring's source. But you don't need to worry about that.

options.text: How do I get out of here?
How do I get out of here?

steps.player: How do I get out of here?

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Now that you have defeated the demon you can come and go as you please. I cast a spell on you which means that you can pass through the flames without harm.

options.text: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: I will remain here in the protection of the flaming octagram and continue my research into the spirit world. My recent experience has made me something of an authority on the subject!

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: But do please visit me here if you have any problems with your Yommi tree. I remember carving my first totem... it's no easy feat!

options.text: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.
How do I get out of here?

growing-a-yommi-tree-looking-at-the-yomm.text: These seeds look magical. They need to be germinated in pure sacred water.

growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujou.speaker: Gujuo
growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujou.text: How goes your quest to free Ungadulu?

options.text: Ungadulu is free! He was possessed by a demon and I killed it.

steps.player: Ungadulu is free! He was possessed by a demon and I killed it.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: A demon? You are truly brave, Bwana. Well done, and thank you for freeing our shaman.

options.text: I have the Yommi tree seeds.
I have the Yommi tree seeds.

steps.player: I have the Yommi tree seeds.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: That's great, Bwana. Now you just need to germinate the seeds and then plant them in some fertile soil. I'm sure that Ungadulu has explained all this to you already.

options.text: Ungadulu is free! He was possessed by a demon and I killed it.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: If you have the Yommi tree seeds, you will need to germinate them.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Place the seeds into pure water, and they will begin to sprout tiny shoots. You can then plant them in fertile soil.

options.text: Ungadulu is free! He was possessed by a demon and I killed it.
I have the Yommi tree seeds.

growing-a-yommi-tree-germinating-the-see.text: You place the seeds into the golden bowl of pure sacred water.
You start to see little shoots growing on the seeds. They're germinating!

growing-a-yommi-tree-looking-at-the-germ.text: These seeds have been germinated in pure sacred water and are ready to be planted in fertile soil.

growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujuo-af.speaker: Gujuo
growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujuo-af.text: Thank you for releasing Ungadulu! My fellow Kharazi and I feel much safer now that our shaman is back. Is the Yommi tree growing well?

options.text: I have germinated the Yommi tree seeds.

steps.player: I have germinated the Yommi tree seeds.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Well done, Bwana. Thanks to your hard work we'll soon have a new totem pole. Now you need to plant the seed in the fertile earth.

options.text: Where can I find fertile soil?
Where can I find fertile soil?

steps.player: Where can I find fertile soil?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: There's lots of fertile ground in the Kharazi jungle. My people have marked the patches we've seen with old wood.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: If you find a rotten tree, or what looks like a rotten totem pole, it's probably on fertile soil.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: You'll need to chop the markers down with a sharp Woodcutting axe.

options.text: I have germinated the Yommi tree seeds.

growing-a-yommi-tree-attempting-to-plant.text: You'll need some pure sacred water to feed the tree when it starts growing.

growing-a-yommi-tree-attempting-to-take-.text: It looks as if this pool has dried up. A thick black sludge has replaced the sparkling pure water, and it smells like death. Maybe Gujuo knows what's happened.
Something's wrong with the sacred water!
A slow but steady trickle of mud and filth is making its way to the surface and then disappearing into the ground again. It stinks!

growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujuo.speaker: Gujuo
growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-gujuo.text: I have visited Ungadulu in the caves. He's hard at work studying, but he looks well! Have you grown the Yommi tree yet?

options.text: The water pool has dried up, but I need more water.

steps.player: The water pool has dried up, but I need more pure water.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: This is indeed a bad omen, Bwana. I've never known the sacred pool to dry up before...

options.text: Does the Yommi tree have to have pure water?

steps.player: Does the Yommi tree have to have pure water?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Of course! It is a magical tree and can only survive on the water from the sacred pool.

options.text: Where's the source of the pure water?
Where's the source of the pure water?

steps.player: Where's the source of the pure water?

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Oh, Bwana, it is a terrible place. Be thankful you don't have to go there.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Bwana, you cannot be thinking of travelling to the source!

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: But I suppose we have no choice...

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: Deep in the caves where you found Ungadulu is a terrible place, guarded by the angry spirits of the undead.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: The legends say they died trying to find the source of the sacred water, and now they are cursed to guard it for all eternity.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: The first to die was a powerful sorcerer, and his strange magic lingers in the cave. Now all who venture near are struck by terror, and cannot proceed.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: With all my heart, Bwana, nothing could convince me to go near such a place.

steps.speaker: Gujuo

options.text: Where's the source of the pure water?

options.text: Where can I get more water for the Yommi tree?

steps.player: Where can I get more water for the Yommi tree?

steps.text: If the pool of sacred water has dried up, there may be a way to get to the source of the spring. But it is said to be very, very dangerous.

options.text: Where's the source of the pure water?
Can you help me reach the source?

Can you help me reach the source?

growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-ungadulu.speaker: Ungadulu
growing-a-yommi-tree-talking-to-ungadulu.text: Hello, Bwana! How is your Yommi tree doing?

options.text: I am on a quest to get more sacred water.

steps.player: I am on a quest to get more sacred water.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Well, if it's sacred water you want, you'd do well to have a look around here.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Long ago, the elders blocked off the entrance to the Viyeldi caves, somewhere in this same cave system. There's bound to be evidence of the entrance somewhere.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Beware though - the caves are deeply cursed, and should you fall, your spirit will be trapped within the caves forever, sworn to protect their secret.

options.text: What do you know about the source of the sacred water?
What do you know about the source of the sacred water?

steps.player: What do you know about the source of the sacred water?

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Many people have tried, and failed, to find it. My great-grandfather told me he once even saw an expedition of dwarves down there!

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: Something terrible must have happened to them, because they never returned.

steps.speaker: Ungadulu
steps.text: They say the spirits of those poor adventurers linger still, cursed to protect the water even in undeath...forever...

options.text: I am on a quest to get more sacred water.

steps.text: If the player already has some seeds:

You mix the two ingredients together

into-the-viyeldi-caves-opening-the-third.text: This strange-looking gate is covered in mysterious symbols. Weirdly, the handle is a glass orb.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-searching-the-thi.text: Upon searching the gate you discover that the metal bars look like letters. You think you could decipher the message - would you like to try?

steps.text: You attempt to read the message on the gate...
To all those with learning and supernatural powers, who with book and rune spend the long dark hours. If further challenges you would endure, give me a taste of your power so pure.

options.text: No, I don't want to read that.

steps.text: You decide not to read the message.
You scour the gate for any more clues, and something etched into the wall nearby catches your eye. It's a picture of four pillars!

Over the first pillar is a picture of a cloud. Etched over the second pillar are flickering flames. Over the third pillar is the carved image of a dew drop, or a tear. Over the fourth pillar is the likeness of a ploughed field.
All four images are contained within separate spheres, much like the orb attached to the gate...

into-the-viyeldi-caves-casting-charge-or.text: The orb attached to the door glows brightly as you charge it. The illusory doors glow, then fade away. Before you know it, you're sucked through the door and into a different part of the cave system.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-opening-the-third.text: You feel yourself being pulled through the portal.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-searching-the-win.text: You see nothing special about this...
Perhaps with a rope, it might be a bit more functional.
You throw a rope around the winch.
You search the wooden beams and find the rope you attached.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-attempting-to-cli.text: It's very dark down there. Are you sure you want to go down?

steps.text: You prepare to climb down the rope.

And you can go no further.

options.text: Actually, maybe this is a bad idea...

options.text: Actually, let me think it over a while longer; it smells a bit odd.

steps.text: You sensibly stopper the vial and place it back in your inventory. You consider that things aren't so desperate yet that you need to rely on strange jungle potions to make you brave.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-bravely-climbing-.text: It's very dark down there. Are you sure you want to go down?

steps.text: You prepare to climb down the rope.
If successful:

Fear stabs at your heart...
...and your hands become sweaty.
You lose your grip on the rope and fall into the pit!
You land on a tall ledge...
It's a long way down!

options.text: Actually, maybe this is a bad idea...

into-the-viyeldi-caves-bravely-climbing-.text: You don't think this is a safe way down.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: Your hand passes through the hat as though it wasn't there at all. Instantly, the other clothes begin to animate and walk towards you!

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.speaker: Viyeldi
into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: Beware, adventurer. You are brave, but braver folk than you have fallen in pursuit of the sacred water.
The spirit wavers slightly and then stands proud.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.speaker: Viyeldi
into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: Perilous dangers do await thee, Tojalon, Senay and Devere make three. None hold malice but will test your might, pray you do not lose these fights.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.speaker: Viyeldi
into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: If, however, you win this day, take heart that see the spring you may.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.speaker: Viyeldi
into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: Through Dragon's eye will you gain new heart. Heed these words, else swiftly depart.

steps.text: The clothes slump to the floor again after he has finished.

into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.speaker: Viyeldi
into-the-viyeldi-caves-picking-up-the-bl.text: Adventurer, I am already deceased, and therefore impervious to your attacks. Still, I can tell when I'm not wanted...
The spirit of Viyeldi crumples back into a pile of clothes. You may have hurt his feelings.
Your hand passes through the hat as though it wasn't there at all.

the-source-of-the-spring.text: A thick green mist seems to emanate from the water... It slowly congeals into the shape of a body.
In a rasping, barely audible voice you hear the entity speak.

the-source-of-the-spring.speaker: Echned Zekin
the-source-of-the-spring.text: Who disturbs the rocks of Zekin?
There seems to be something slightly familiar about this presence.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: So, you desire the sacred water that flows here?

options.text: Yes, I need it for my quest.

steps.player: Yes, I need it for my quest.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: The water babbles so loudly and I am already so tortured. I cannot abide the sound, so I have stoppered the streams. Care you not for my torment and pain?

options.text: What can I do about that?
Not really, I just wondered if I could push that big rock.

steps.player: Not really, I just wondered if I could push that big rock.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: The rock must remain! I placed it there to stop the sound of the water's babbling. The noise troubles my soul and I seek a little rest... rest from this terrible torture...

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: I was robbed of my life by a cruel man named Viyeldi. For centuries I have searched for him, so I might enact my vengeance.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: But, oh! Tragedy of tragedies, while searching for the source of the sacred water, his spirit became trapped! Now he is neither living nor dead, and I will never be released from my torment.

options.text: What can I do about that?

steps.player: What can I do about that?

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: I was brutally murdered by a vicious man called Viyeldi. I sense his presence nearby.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: My spirit burns with the need for revenge. While that fiend yet lives, I cannot rest. If you seek the sacred water, you must ensure he meets his end.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: If you refuse, then I swear, the sacred water shall never flow again! Will you put an end to Viyeldi for me?

options.text: I'll do what I must to get the water.

steps.player: I'll do what I must to get the water.

steps.text: The shapeless spirit seems to crackle with energy.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: Destroy Viyeldi, and the sacred water is yours. But beware, for this is no simple task.
If the player doesn't have the dark dagger:

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: I will furnish you with a weapon which will destroy Viyeldi for good. Here, take this.
The spirit waves an arm and in front of you appears a dark dagger hewn from pure obsidian.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: To complete your task you must use this weapon on Viyeldi.
If the player has the dark dagger:

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: Use this dagger to slay the fiendish Viyeldi, and bring it back to me once he is dead... for good, this time.
The formless shape shimmers brightly...

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: You've made the right decision. Soon, the sacred water will be yours. Bring the dagger back to me when you have completed your task.

options.text: I've changed my mind, I can't do it.

steps.player: I've changed my mind, I can't do it.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: That's your decision. Are you sure you don't need the sacred water, though? Deny me, and it will forever be out of your reach...

options.text: I'll do what I must to get the water.
No, I won't take someone's life for you.
No, I won't take someone's life for you.

steps.text: A noble sentiment, but Viyeldi is not alive! He is merely a vessel for the sacred water's power.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: If that is your decision then so be it, but I cannot allow access to the stream until Viyeldi is dead.

options.text: Can't I just get some water?

steps.player: Can't I just get some water?

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: First, you must help me. Revenge is the only thing that keeps my spirit in this place.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin

options.text: I'll do what I must to get the water.

steps.text: The hooded, headless figure turns to face you... It's quite unnerving.

options.text: What can I do about that?

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: I am long since dead and buried, lost in the passages of time. My kin have departed and I am forgotten by all who knew me... so it is unlikely that you were one of them. I am but a poor tortured soul, trying to get

options.text: What can I do about that?

options.text: Who am I supposed to kill again?

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: I seek revenge on Viyeldi, the cruel fiend who slew me centuries ago.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin

the-source-of-the-spring-using-the-dark-.speaker: Echned Zekin

steps.text: Very well, I respect your decision - but I cannot allow you to access the sacred water while my tormentor lives.

steps.speaker: Echned Zekin
steps.text: Very well, return to me when it is done.

options.text: I have found the source of the sacred water!

steps.text: Deeper in the caves where you found Ungadulu is a terrible place, guarded by the angry spirits of the undead.

steps.speaker: Gujuo
steps.text: The legends say they died trying to find the source of the sacred water, and now they are cursed to guard it for all eternity.
